adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `refreshOAuthTokens` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts) which, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, performs an inline `await fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` with no AbortController/timeout. Multiple integrations now call this helper inside their token refresh paths (e.g., google/office365/zoom/webex CalendarService/VideoApiAdapter), so if that endpoint hangs the awaiting request can block those flows. The specific claim that it occurs during "service construction" isn’t directly shown, but the no-timeout inline await is verifiable and is an operational robustness concern introduced by the diff.
